minutes.headline: Commission approved corrected minutes and will ask the town manager how it can help move the Brooks House sale forward.
minutes.summary: The commission corrected and approved its October minutes, then discussed the Brooks House: the warrant article passed at town meeting, and members favoured advising the select board to attach performance conditions or a bond to any sale. It also heard updates on the Municipal Building design committee's architect selection, Town Hall and Ritter building repair bids, a non-compliant property at 50 Main Street, and the master plan survey. No members of the public attended, and the next meeting was aimed at 19 December.

decisions.decision: The chair will meet the town manager (and possibly the land use director) to ask how the commission can help the Brooks House process, and raise concerns about performance conditions on any sale.
The chair will suggest the town manager bring in business people to help shape the proposal terms, rather than the commission canvassing businesses itself.
A letter will be sent to the owner of 50 Main Street about non-compliance with the preservation bylaw, with a report back in December.
Aim for a December meeting on the 19th, subject to room availability, with Zoom as the fallback.
